subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a narrow 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline in core after this branch is rebased and repaired, or pause this PR in favor of broader calendar/week-view product design?
rationale: The linked issue asks for a broader calendar/timeline UX, while this PR implements a narrower feature slice and now needs a non-trivial port onto the current Control UI architecture.

options.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Rebase or replace this PR as a narrow 24-hour timeline slice, then fix the status, scheduler, state-color, and i18n blockers before merge.

options.title: Design Full Calendar Scope
options.body: Pause the implementation until maintainers decide the daily, weekly, stats, and editing behavior requested by the canonical issue.

options.title: Decline Core Timeline
options.body: Close this PR and keep or close the canonical issue based on an explicit decision that the current list/run-history UI is enough for core.

recommendation.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace this PR as a narrow 24-hour timeline slice, then fix the status, scheduler, state-color, and i18n blockers before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main Cron UI/status evidence and recent history point most strongly to this owner for the rebase/product-surface decision.
